editorial.marketOverview: Friday's shortened session saw Nasdaq rise 2.31%, SOX about 4.7%, and Russell 2000 1.7%. AP confirms the broad weekly rebound, including Russell 2000 up 6.5%. Micron and Marvell led Friday chips while Nvidia lagged. The recovery is historical and holiday liquidity limits extrapolation.
editorial.whatChanged: The 08:37 ET repository report retains score -12 and consolidation risk 16. Open Watch timestamp is unchanged. Fresh WSJ reporting places Friday 10Y near 4.933%, corroborating repository 4.936% without establishing synchronized 2Y timing. NY Fed calendar confirms Tuesday ISM/JOLTS and Wednesday ADP; construction spending and labor tightness are additional scheduled releases. No material path change.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The rebound remains a relief move pending normal liquidity. Repository VXN 33.34 and VIX 23.81 suggest cooling but underlying timestamps are unknown. Repository yields 4.936% and 4.710% imply 22.6 bp without rescaling; WSJ later reporting corroborates the 10Y level. Friday Fed pricing remains restrictive and Reuters reports Brent 95.44 and WTI 83.08 settlements. Weekend supply developments are prospective, not observed equity reactions.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday tests the relief rally after Sunday's pending OPEC+ decision. Tuesday manufacturing PMI, ISM, JOLTS and construction spending can reprice rates; Marvell and Credo after-close guidance may shape Wednesday chips. Wednesday ADP and labor tightness data add rate risk, with Salesforce and Snowflake after close. Friday payrolls and the December Fed meeting are outside the horizon but may influence positioning.
editorial.bullCase: Sustained chip outperformance and broad participation under normal liquidity, stable or falling yields and further volatility cooling would support a continuation. Constructive chip guidance could strengthen demand confidence.
editorial.bearCase: Renewed oil supply pressure, a 10Y move above 5%, narrowing breadth or weaker chip guidance could reverse the relief rally. Hot macro releases could reinforce tightening expectations.
editorial.watchNext: Watch OPEC+ outcome, Sunday futures reopening, Monday synchronized cross-asset prices and breadth, Tuesday macro releases and chip earnings, and Wednesday ADP and earnings reaction. Do not infer weekend equity responses from news alone.
